question:
Six boxes P, Q, R, S, T and U are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. P is kept third from the bottom. Only two boxes are kept between P and Q. Only three boxes are kept between Q and R. S is kept immediately below R. T is kept immediately below Q.

How many boxes are kept between U and S?
